kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَلُوقِيّ • (salūqiyy) m (plural سَلُوقِيّات (salūqiyyāt) or سَلَالِيق (salālīq), feminine سَلُوقِيَّة (salūqiyya))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: سَلُوق (salūq) + ـِيّ (-iyy), a village in Yemen, according to Arabic tradition, however there are homonymic settlement names to consider, including three named سَلُوقِيَّة (salūqiyya), Seleucia on the Tigris, Seleucia in Pieria, Seleucia on the Calycadnus.
s: مَعَهم ضَوار من سَلوق كأنها حُصُن تَجولٌ تُجَرَّرُ الأَرْسَانا
